facts.fact: The paper presents an unsupervised learning approach to building a non-English (Arabic) stemmer.
facts.supporting_span: This paper presents an unsupervised learning approach to building a non-English (Arabic) stemmer .

facts.fact: The stemming model is based on statistical machine translation.
facts.supporting_span: The stemming model is based on statistical machine translation

facts.fact: The stemming model uses an English stemmer and a small (10K sentences) parallel corpus as its sole training resources.
facts.supporting_span: The stemming model is based on statistical machine translation and it uses an English stemmer and a small (10K sentences) parallel corpus as its sole training resources .

facts.fact: No parallel text is needed after the training phase.
facts.supporting_span: No parallel text is needed after the training phase .

facts.fact: Monolingual, unannotated text can be used to further improve the stemmer.
facts.supporting_span: Monolingual , unannotated text can be used to further improve the stemmer

facts.fact: Monolingual, unannotated text can be used to allow the stemmer to adapt to a desired domain or genre.
facts.supporting_span: Monolingual , unannotated text can be used to further improve the stemmer by allowing it to adapt to a desired domain or genre .

facts.fact: Examples and results will be given for Arabic.
facts.supporting_span: Examples and results will be given for Arabic

facts.fact: The approach is applicable to any language that needs affix removal.
facts.supporting_span: the approach is applicable to any language that needs affix removal .

Our resource-frugal approach results in 87.5 % agreement with a state of the art , proprietary Arabic stemmer built using rules , affix lists , and human annotated text , in addition to an unsupervised component .
